frame: 0x507 CarMakerSteeringTruth (internal HIL transport, CarMaker -> SpeedgoatHIL on the CarMaker bus / IO614 channel 1)
provisional: CAN ID 0x507 is PROVISIONAL -- no authoritative vehicle-wide CAN ID registry exists. The ID is unused elsewhere in this repository, but that is a HIL-local audit, not vehicle-wide approval.
derivation: Hand-derived from BO_ 1287 in carmaker/config/MFE26_Inverter_CarMaker.dbc by tmp/gen_golden_steering.py, which re-implements the scale, byte order and CRC independently. NOT produced by running decodeCarMakerSteeringFrame.m or IO.c.
scaling: angle 0.001 rad/count, signed int16. RADIANS on the wire because radians is the unit of the CarMaker source quantity Steer.WhlAng; the rad -> deg conversion happens once on the Speedgoat, just before Bosch LWS encoding.
integrity: byte 6 is the modulo-256 truth-group counter SHARED with 0x503-0x506; byte 7 CRC-8/SAE-J1850 over bytes 0-6 (poly 0x1D, init 0xFF, non-reflected, xorout 0xFF)
signConvention: left-hand-positive (CarMaker / ISO 8855, matching the Bosch LWS)
range: The decoder accepts |angle| <= 13.614 rad, which is 13614 counts -- the Bosch LWS +/-780 deg limit quantised to whole counts. Testing against the unrounded 13.6135... rad would reject the sender's own saturation value.
downstream: The SpeedgoatHIL LWS emulator, not CarMaker, turns this into the Bosch LWS 0x2B0 frame, and derives LWS_SPEED from successive 10 ms samples of this angle. 0x507 never reaches the VC bus.

accepted.name: cmsteer_one_lsb
accepted.note: one count = 0.001 rad = 0.0573 deg, the transport resolution

accepted.name: cmsteer_minus_one_lsb
accepted.note: -1 count = 0xFFFF LE; proves the field is signed, not offset

accepted.name: cmsteer_plus105_fanatec_max
accepted.note: +105 deg = the active Fanatec Device.0 Steer.Whl_MaxDeg; left-hand-positive (CarMaker / ISO 8855)

accepted.name: cmsteer_minus105_fanatec_min
accepted.note: -105 deg = the active Fanatec Device.0 Steer.Whl_MinDeg

accepted.name: cmsteer_plus450_device1_max
accepted.note: +450 deg = the disabled Device.1 range; the 0.001 rad/count scale must already cover it

accepted.name: cmsteer_full_left
accepted.note: +780 deg = the Bosch LWS measuring range, quantised to 13614 counts; the decoder's accept limit is exactly this value

accepted.name: cmsteer_full_right
accepted.note: -780 deg = the Bosch LWS measuring range; counter about to wrap 255->0

accepted.name: cmsteer_counter_wrap
accepted.note: counter wrapped 255->0; a decoder must treat this as advancing

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_short_dlc
rejected.expectation: REJECT wrong_dlc. The frame is always DLC 8.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_reserved_nonzero
rejected.expectation: REJECT reserved_nonzero. Bytes 2-5 must be zero; a non-zero reserved byte flags a sender still using the superseded degrees+speed layout.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_bad_crc
rejected.expectation: REJECT integrity_failure. Byte 7 is not the CRC-8/SAE-J1850 of bytes 0-6.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_angle_over_range
rejected.expectation: REJECT out_of_range. 13615 counts = 13.615 rad is one count past the quantised Bosch +/-780 deg limit; the previously retained value is kept.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_extended
rejected.expectation: REJECT extended_frame. 0x507 is an 11-bit standard ID.
